title: master workspace ad warning
scenario: Current repository enters AD with global conditional-admission PD still present.

title: user-mgmt dd warning
scenario: Current repository enters DD after the user-mgmt pilot documents are created.

title: user-mgmt tasks warning
scenario: Current repository enters tasks after plan inherits the global conditional-admission risk.

title: user-mgmt implement warning
scenario: Current repository enters implement with explicit unfinished declarations but no real blocker row.

title: stale rule reference
scenario: Rule file still references a deleted source document.

title: partial pd without admission
scenario: PD README contains partial coverage markers but no AD/DD admission statement.

title: missing ad
scenario: DD stage starts without ad.md or ad/.

title: plan missing core chains
scenario: plan.md does not define core business chains or real success signals.

title: plan missing pd handoff
scenario: Conditional-admission PD risk is not inherited into plan.md.

title: missing tasks
scenario: Implement stage starts without tasks/ or tasks.md.

title: real blocker row present
scenario: plan/tasks contains an actual BLOCKER status row or blocker field.

title: unfinished declarations only
scenario: plan/tasks contains Deferred or Out of Scope but no real blocker row.

title: module missing from rollout and state
scenario: Target module is missing from both module-rollout.json and module-state.json.

title: dependency not browser verified
scenario: Target module dependencies are not yet browser_verified or done.

title: browser stage without valid module
scenario: Browser gate runs without a target module or from an invalid module state.

title: critical performance target missing
scenario: Critical module has browser quality probes but is missing performance targets.
